title: Associated log structures: construction, universal property and geometric stalks
statement:
Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], let $R$ be a commutative monoid, and let $\beta:R\to\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a homomorphism to the multiplicative monoid of global regular functions. For an etale $U\to X$ [def-weil-etale-morphism] put $B_U=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$ and let $\beta_U:R\to B_U$ be restriction of $\beta$. The presheaf of monoids $U\mapsto R\oplus_{\beta_U^{-1}(B_U^\times)}B_U^\times$, where $(re,u)$ is identified with $(r,\beta_U(e)u)$, has a sheafification as a sheaf of commutative monoids [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. With structure map $[r,u]\mapsto\beta_U(r)u$, this sheaf $L_X(R,\beta)$ is a log structure in the sense of [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], with canonical map $\iota:R\to L_X(R,\beta)(X)$.

For every log structure $K$ on $X$, composition with $\iota$ is a bijection from homomorphisms of log structures $L_X(R,\beta)\to K$ over the identity of $X$ to monoid homomorphisms $v:R\to K(X)$ satisfying $\alpha_K v=\beta$. A homomorphism of log structures over the identity means a homomorphism of sheaves compatible with the maps to $\mathcal O_X$; it fixes the canonical copy of $\mathcal O_X^\times$. For every geometric point $\bar x$ [def-weil-geometric-point], writing $A=\mathcal O_{X,\bar x}$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] and $E=\beta_{\bar x}^{-1}(A^\times)$, the canonical map $R\oplus_E A^\times\to L_X(R,\beta)_{\bar x}$ is an isomorphism, compatible with $R$ and $A^\times$. For every etale $U\to X$, restriction identifies $L_X(R,\beta)|_U$ canonically with $L_U(R,\beta_U)$. A chart $R\to K(X)$ in the sense of [def-trf-fs-log-blowup] identifies $K$ with this associated log structure, so the same universal property applies to $K$.

source.place: Expose VI, 1.1, printed p. 69: associated-log and chart conventions, referring to Kato (1988), section 1. Explicit construction, universal property and stalk formula are isolated here; the underlying Kato reference is WANTED in the report.

proof.text: Specialize prelog_pushout_log_axiom to the constant presheaf ULift R with structure map beta restricted to every etale object. Its pair map is surjective with the exact generated kernel. Descend the pair map to the actual associatedLogPresheaf, prove its components bijective by quotient induction, and transport the generic sheafification unit and structural formula across this presheaf isomorphism. The log structure uses the generic theorem only through its forced structural data and proof fields.

Apply prelog_pushout_hom_extension to the same presentation. Build natural maps from the constant presheaf by restricting global charts. Naturality at the terminal etale object determines every component, proving injectivity and the exact compatible range of composition with iota.

The normalized geometric-stalk comparison supplies the prescribed pushout isomorphisms and proves that iota is a global chart. This is the one geometric-stalk calculation isolated from original steps 6--8.

Apply etaleLogPresentation_restriction to the constant prelog presheaf. Its local Noetherianity conclusion permits constructing an associated-log presentation on U. Identify its prelog structural map with the restricted beta and apply the comparison to this chosen presentation, keeping both its pair formula and alpha equation.

The exact compatible range from Step 2 produces a structural map f from L into any compatible charted K. The two global charts and their equality under f give IsIso f by global-chart recognition. Form asIso f, prove compatibility of its inverse with alpha and the chart, and transport the full injectivity and exact compatible range by precomposition with its hom and inverse.

The Lean proof includes quotient comparison, terminal-object naturality, and categorical transport of universality.
